_comment: Synthetic, fictional test inputs for the HARP conformance suite. No PHI. The reference server in ../reference ships a dev ID-JAG minter at POST /dev/mint-id-jag, so the suite mints a trusted assertion at run time rather than hardcoding a signed token. For a third-party service you certify, replace org_id / accepted_by / login_hint and supply your own trusted ID-JAG issuer per CONFORMANCE.md section 'How to self-certify', step 3.
subject: user_synthetic_001

_notes.phi_scope: A PHI scope offered by the reference server. The suite reads the live scope list from discovery and overrides this if it is not offered.
_notes.protected_resource_path: The reference server exposes /eligibility guarded by the phi_scope. A third-party service supplies its own protected path.
